title: Are You Hearing Him
speaker: Diana Phillips
description:
Are You Hearing Him | Hearing the Holy Spirit, Living Genuine Faith, Surrender, and Obedience - James v1:1-27

God does not call us to a shallow profession, but to a surrendered life that bears the reflection of Christ. In James v1, trials produce endurance, wisdom is given to those who ask in faith, and real devotion is seen in mercy, humility, and obedience. We are not our own; we have been bought with a price, and the Lord shapes us through testing so that our lives grow steady, generous, and true.

The call is to be doers of the word and not hearers only. Our speech, our treatment of others, our forgiveness, and our compassion all reveal what fills the heart. Faith is never empty talk; it moves toward people in love, gives freely, and stays unstained by the world.

As we surrender every sin, stay rooted in Scripture, and grow still before God, we learn to recognize the voice of the Holy Spirit. He speaks through His Word, confirms His truth, and leads His people in prayer, witness, and mercy. James v1:22 reminds us that a changed life is the evidence of a living faith.
